where.if: d.name_en ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR d.makani_name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR d.name_ar ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR d.municipality ILIKE #{q}

mapper.select:
SELECT d.code, d.name_en, d.name_ar, d.sort_no, d.municipality, d.makani_district_id, ST_X(d.centroid) AS centroid_lon, ST_Y(d.centroid) AS centroid_lat, ST_XMin(d.bbox) AS min_lon, ST_YMin(d.bbox) AS min_lat, ST_XMax(d.bbox) AS max_lon, ST_YMax(d.bbox) AS max_lat, m.area_km2, l.score_current, l.is_sample AS liv_sample, (l.district_code IS NOT NULL) AS liv_present FROM stat.dim_district d LEFT JOIN stat.stat_district_makani m ON m.district_code = d.code LEFT JOIN stat.stat_district_liveability l ON l.district_code = d.code
ORDER BY d.sort_no LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT use_desc, plot_count FROM stat.stat_district_landuse WHERE district_code = #{code}
SELECT month, transactions FROM stat.stat_district_adrec_monthly WHERE district_code = #{code} ORDER BY month

SELECT json_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'features', coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'id', d.sort_no, 'properties', json_build_object( 'code', d.code, 'nameEn', d.name_en, 'nameAr', d.name_ar, 'sortNo', d.sort_no, 'municipality', d.municipality, 'makaniDistrictId', d.makani_district_id, 'areaKm2', m.area_km2, 'liveabilityScore', l.score_current, 'livSample', l.is_sample, 'centroid', json_build_array(round(ST_X(d.centroid)::numeric, 6), round(ST_Y(d.centroid)::numeric, 6)), 'bbox', json_build_array(round(ST_XMin(d.bbox)::numeric, 6), round(ST_YMin(d.bbox)::numeric, 6), round(ST_XMax(d.bbox)::numeric, 6), round(ST_YMax(d.bbox)::numeric, 6))), 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(d.boundary, 5)::json) ORDER BY d.sort_no), '[]'::json) )::text FROM stat.dim_district d LEFT JOIN stat.stat_district_makani m ON m.district_code = d.code LEFT JOIN stat.stat_district_liveability l ON l.district_code = d.code WHERE d.boundary IS NOT NULL

WITH bounds AS (SELECT ST_TileEnvelope(#{z}, #{x}, #{y}) AS env), mvt AS ( SELECT ST_AsMVTGeom(b.geom, bounds.env, 4096, 64, true) AS geom, b.district_code AS code, b.height::float8 AS height, b.under_construction AS uc FROM stat.map_building b, bounds WHERE b.geom && bounds.env ) SELECT coalesce(ST_AsMVT(mvt.*, 'buildings', 4096, 'geom'), ''::bytea) AS mvt FROM mvt

WITH bounds AS (SELECT ST_TileEnvelope(#{z}, #{x}, #{y}) AS env), mvt AS ( SELECT ST_AsMVTGeom(p.geom, bounds.env, 4096, 64, true) AS geom, p.district_code AS code, p.plot_id AS plot_id, p.status AS status, p.use_desc AS use_desc FROM stat.map_plot p, bounds WHERE p.geom && bounds.env ) SELECT coalesce(ST_AsMVT(mvt.*, 'plots', 4096, 'geom'), ''::bytea) AS mvt FROM mvt

WITH s AS ( SELECT 'makani' AS source, count(*)::int AS row_count, max(source_as_of) AS source_as_of, false AS sample FROM stat.stat_district_makani UNION ALL SELECT 'liveability', count(*)::int, max(source_as_of), bool_or(is_sample) FROM stat.stat_district_liveability UNION ALL SELECT 'adrec', count(*)::int, max(source_as_of), bool_or(is_sample) FROM stat.stat_district_adrec ) SELECT s.source, s.row_count, s.source_as_of, s.sample, j.status AS last_status, j.started_at AS last_started_at, j.finished_at AS last_finished_at, j.message AS last_message FROM s LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT status, started_at, finished_at, message FROM stat.etl_job_log WHERE source = s.source ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) j ON true
SELECT code, name_en, municipality, makani_district_id, encode(ST_AsEWKB(scope), 'hex') AS scope_hex FROM stat.dim_district WHERE scope IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sort_no
